test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true according to the passage?

options.text: After the War of Independence, Britain had colonies in North America.
In the mid-19th century the towns grew and most people were engaged in mining and manufacturing.
In 18th century England almost half the population consisted of poor people.
Before the Industrial Revolution, most of the people in England lived in villages and were engaged in agriculture.

solution:
The correct answer is "**After the War of Independence, Britain had colonies in North America.**"
